stances.summary: Criticizes Democrats for failing to learn from electoral losses
Questions viability of left-populist movements post-Sanders
stances.quote: The Future of the Left After Sanders (by Justin Vassallo). Are there any insurgents capable of building a similar left-populist political movement?

stances.summary: Notes progressive candidates lost Illinois primaries, center holds
stances.quote: The Democratic Center Holds—For Now (by Henry Olsen). Democratic elites breathed another sigh of relief after Tuesday’s Illinois primaries as the most radical progressive candidates for Congress all lost.

stances.summary: Democratic ticket choice reflects shift toward moderate messaging
stances.quote: Democrats’ Return to Walz-ism (by Michael Baharaeen). When Kamala Harris announced that Minnesota Governor Tim Walz would be her running mate in 2024, my first reaction was curious optimism for the Democratic ticket.

stances.summary: Democrats self-inflicted messaging and ideas deficit costs them elections
stances.quote: Democrats Have a Billion-Dollar Idea Problem—And It's Self-Inflicted

stances.summary: White liberal voters pose electoral challenge for Democrats
Examines whether Obama could succeed in modern Democratic primary
stances.quote: Could Obama Win a Democratic Primary Today? (by Michael Baharaeen)

stances.summary: Democrats lack credible economic growth program
stances.quote: Democrats Don’t Have a Growth Program

stances.summary: Trump's tariff policy became liability until Iran conflict intervened
stances.quote: Is Economic Nationalism Fading Among Voters? (by Justin Vassallo). Until the U.S.-Israeli war in Iran took center stage, Trump’s unyielding faith in tariffs had become his party’s chief liability heading into the midterms.

stances.summary: Both parties have damaged federal government trust and function
stances.quote: How Can Government Serve the People When So Few Trust It? (by John Halpin). Both parties have driven the federal government into the ground.

stances.summary: Both parties enforce ideological conformity over intellectual diversity
stances.quote: Neither Party Is Interested in “Heterodoxy” (by John Halpin). They talk a big game about big tents and pluralism, but partisan fealty and ideological conformity always win out.

stances.summary: Observes conservative populism as established Western political force
stances.quote: The Future of Conservative Populism (by Henry Olsen). Conservative populism has now firmly established itself as a significant force in most of the Western world.
